quote: automatic songwriting has drawn much attention from both academia and industry. Automatic songwriting covers many tasks, such as lyric generation, melody generation, lyric-to-melody generation, and melody-to-lyric generation.
In this paper, we focus on lyric-to-melody generation, since it is one of the most important and common tasks in songwriting and is still under-explored.

Objective Evaluation Following Sheng et al., we consider two metrics to measure the similarity of the generated and the ground-truth melodies: Similarity of pitch and duration distribution (PD and DD) and Melody distance (MD). Besides, we use accuracy of tonality, chord, rhythm pattern, and cadence (TA, CA, RA, AA) to measure the consistency between the generated melody and musical elements in the template.
